items.summary: Remove offers workspace route/templates/role/docs
items.notes: Offers workspace removed. External c2.t-mobile.com/offers links remain.

items.summary: Add inline CSS/JS regression tests (baseline-based)
items.notes: Baseline-based pytest guardrails added; future PRs must not increase violations.

items.summary: Add frontend standards + how-to + checklist + components
items.notes: Docs are enforceable via CI checks and review checklist.

items.summary: Add admin page rendering tracking JSON
items.notes: Admin route `/admin/ui-refactor` renders the tracking JSON as a table.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from landing templates; scope styles in landing.css
items.notes: Moved large inline <style> blocks from landing templates into static/css/landing.css, scoped by body classes (landing--standard / landing--fullscreen) to avoid impacting /research pages. Removed inline disabled-card styles by switching to an is-disabled class.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from research templates; migrate to research.css/pete.css
items.notes: Removed inline style attributes and <style> blocks from templates/research/*.html. Migrated Research Home CSS into static/css/research.css (scoped to body.research--home) and PETE rules into static/css/pete.css (scoped to body.research--pete). Added small global helper classes to static/css/styles.css for shared layout pieces used in research_base.html.

items.summary: Create shared partials; dedupe header/footer/theme
items.notes: Created shared Jinja partials under templates/partials for theme init, theme toggle UI, theme toggle script, and footer clock. Updated landing_base.html, research_base.html, and pam_base.html to include these partials. Removed inline footer/link styles and inline sortable-table CSS from pam_base.html (moved sortable CSS into static/css/styles.css).

items.summary: Make footer icons visible in light mode
items.notes: Updated static/css/styles.css footer link color: light mode uses magenta token; dark mode keeps icons white.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from PAM placeholder templates; migrate to pam_placeholders.css
items.notes: Removed <style> blocks and inline style attributes from templates/pam/offers_placeholder.html and templates/pam/research_placeholder.html; added static/css/pam_placeholders.css and linked via extra_css.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from reviewers.html; migrate into reviewers.css
items.notes: Removed inline <style> block and remaining style attributes from templates/pam/reviewers.html. Moved styles to static/css/reviewers.css and replaced inline display/white-space styles with classes.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from edit_rdc.html; migrate into edit_rdc.css/jira_modal.css
items.notes: Removed inline <style> block and all style attributes from templates/pam/edit_rdc.html. Moved diagnostic + SQL/Notes styles into static/css/edit_rdc.css and added a class-based default hidden state for the JIRA modal in static/css/jira_modal.css.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from edit_spe.html; migrate into edit_spe.css
items.notes: Removed the remaining inline style attribute from templates/pam/edit_spe.html (SMS fields container). Added a class-based `display: contents` rule in static/css/edit_spe.css and switched the template JS to toggle the global `hidden` utility class instead of setting style.display.

items.summary: Remove redundant inline style from admin.html
items.notes: Removed a leftover inline style attribute from templates/pam/admin.html; the `.small-hint` styles already exist in static/css/admin.css.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from admin_groupings.html; migrate into admin_groupings.css
items.notes: Removed all inline style attributes from templates/pam/admin_groupings.html. Added class-based replacements in static/css/admin_groupings.css. Updated the embedded JS to toggle the global `hidden` utility class instead of using `.style.display`, and removed an inline style from JS-generated markup by using a CSS class.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from admin_pam_promotions.html; migrate into admin.css
items.notes: Removed all inline style attributes from templates/pam/admin_pam_promotions.html. Replaced inline-colored status spans and inline-styled empty-table rows inside the embedded script with class-based equivalents. Added narrowly-scoped replacement CSS rules to static/css/admin.css under the `.admin-dashboard--pam-promotions` wrapper.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from get_promo_codes.html; migrate into get_promo_codes.css
items.notes: Removed inline style attributes from templates/pam/get_promo_codes.html, including an inline style embedded in a JS template string for the Orbit ID input. Added equivalent class-based rules to static/css/get_promo_codes.css (stacked controls layout, full-width inputs container, and max-width for Orbit ID input).

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from date_mismatch.html; migrate into date_mismatch.css
items.notes: Removed inline styles from templates/pam/date_mismatch.html for the SQL preview container and the SQL preview textarea inside the embedded JS template string. The SQL preview now uses the existing `hidden` utility class for show/hide, and the monospace textarea styling moved into static/css/date_mismatch.css via `.dm-sql-textarea`.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from version_history.html; migrate into version_history.css
items.notes: Removed inline styles from templates/pam/version_history.html for the per-page pagination form and label. Added equivalent layout + font sizing rules to static/css/version_history.css under `.pagination-container .per-page-select`.

items.summary: Remove inline CSS from capacity.html dynamic row-count; keep layout
items.notes: Removed the inline `style="--row-count: ..."` from templates/pam/capacity.html. Preserved the dynamic row-height behavior by moving the value to a `data-row-count` attribute and setting the `--row-count` CSS variable via a small DOMContentLoaded script.

items.summary: Remove inline styles from research.js; use hidden + CSS classes
items.notes: Refactored static/js/research.js to toggle query console visibility via the global `hidden` utility class instead of `.style.display`. Replaced an inline `style="cursor:pointer"` in JS-generated table rows with a `.research-clickable-row` class and added the cursor rule to static/css/research.css.

items.summary: Remove inline styles from jira_modal.js; migrate to jira_modal.css
items.notes: Refactored static/js/jira_modal.js to avoid `.style.display` and `.style.cssText`; modal visibility now toggles via the existing `is-hidden` class. The success toast and DCD preview overlay now use CSS classes, with styling moved into static/css/jira_modal.css. Removed inline `style=` attributes from runtime-generated markup.

items.summary: Remove runtime <style> injection from pam_base.html
items.notes: Removed the DOMContentLoaded script in templates/pam/pam_base.html that created and appended a `<style>` tag to force caret-color. The same behavior is already covered by the global caret override rules in static/css/global.css.

items.summary: Remove misplaced Streamlit PETE script under templates
items.notes: Deleted templates/research/pete.py (a legacy Streamlit script containing inline `<style>` markup and unrelated to the Flask/Jinja templates). The active PETE page is templates/research/pete.html.

items.summary: Remove inline style from rejection email body
items.notes: Removed the inline color style from the HTML rejection message in promo/routes.py (rejection_body) to comply with the repo-wide no-inline-style policy.
